content.comment_body: Is it possible to create a log file using only Microsoft Excel? If viewing data directly in [product_name] Web Editor would be great.
If you're referring to data logging, there currently isn't a way to access it via [product_name] Web Editor—it's only available in Microsoft Excel.

Hello [user_name] and fellow members, Considering the popularity of this topic, it seems many users are eager for a way to read log files stored on the SD card using [product_name] Web Editor or similar tools. Alternative solutions like Node-RED or Snap7 are not user-friendly for most. Personally, I would be interested in purchasing an updated [product_name] Communication Module with built-in log reading features or a fully functional IoT device without needing programming skills. While exporting to Excel works for single devices, most newer applications involve multiple or remote units. I appreciate the [product_name] for its cost and capabilities, but my feedback isn't about needing updates to the controller itself. As electricians and automation professionals, we want modules that collaborate smoothly and can be expanded as our needs grow. Currently, we are forced to learn about databases, Linux, and more to keep up. If there's a way to request these features from the [product_name] team, please inform us!

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are looking for a built-in method to access and display log data from the PLC directly in [product_name] Web Editor, without depending only on Microsoft Excel or complex custom integrations. Current alternatives like Node-RED or Snap7 are seen as impractical for typical users, and there's interest in updated hardware modules with enhanced log access designed for professionals who aren't software experts.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect easy and direct access to historical log data through the [product_name] Web Editor, aiming for a seamless experience where hardware modules work together out-of-the-box and manual or advanced programming steps are minimized.
pain_keywords: unable to view logs in web interface
